description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pituwala, Elpitiya D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810755 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) in various locations. The content focuses on land ownership adjudication and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
